{{Quote|Dooba! Dooba! Look! Branli hurt her finger!|Branli's owner to Dooba|<ref name="Galladinium's Fantastic Technology">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>}}
'''Branli''' was the name of a [[Doll/Legends|doll]] made of [[Plasticene/Legends|plasticene]]. Her [[Unidentified child (Branli)|owner]] was cared for by a [[MK 8001 Attendant Droid]] by the name of [[Dooba]]. When Branli's finger was broken after falling off a [[grav slide]], Dooba fixed it.
